use.flag: Enable advanced variable-reordering algorithms using dev-libs/boost
Enable the BuDDy finite-domain decision diagram backend using LTSmin's compatible private fork
Enable the Petri Net Markup Language frontend
Enable the ProB frontend and prob2lts tools
Enable gperftools profiling support in spgsolver
Install the SpinS compiler for Promela models

pkgmetadata.longdescription: LTSmin is a language-independent model-checking toolset built around the Partitioned Interface to the Next-State function (PINS). It provides sequential, multicore and symbolic exploration algorithms and frontends for transition-system formats and modeling tools such as ETF, DVE, Promela, PNML and ProB.
